Comment: Scoped inline policy for the ubuntu-ami sample's BUILD-HOST instance role, created and attached by scripts/00a-iam.sh. The role also gets the AWS-managed AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy (SSM Session Manager / Run Command, no inbound rule needed). This document is the build host's own permissions: it reads the Canonical EKS base-AMI SSM parameter and writes the on-image provenance manifest; it does NOT create EC2/EKS resources (setup.sh does that from the operator's own credentials). Resource ARNs are intentionally left as the shared-default placeholders the README documents; scripts/00a-iam.sh substitutes the running Region and account at creation time.
